method: All phases use live JEV with unchanged0.9 gates. Known setup/reset is excluded and separately timed. Warm timer includes fresh observation, model decisions, native input and independent fresh AX verification. Screenshot recorder up to5fps uses a separate connection; all frame request/completion intervals retained. No audio. No failed input is replayed. Every attempt and recovery is retained. This is a bounded-intent benchmark, not a human or market-wide speed comparison.
